decisions.reason: The renamed 518 FLEX builds on the established BASIC 518, which already has a following, so its value is partly proven and keeping it costs little.
The flail shredder line has its own page and its prospects are still uncertain one year after launch, so keeping this low-cost option open is sensible.
The grinder line is only mentioned and gives little evidence yet, but it fits the core mobile business, so it is kept open while uncertainty resolves.
This single stationary fine shredder has the weakest visibility and overlaps with other shredders, but one year is too early to abandon the option.
The green-waste grinder line overlaps with Product C and could later be consolidated, yet its results are not clear enough to justify dropping it now.
The stationary pre-shredder line is prominently presented and supports the push toward plant solutions, so it is worth keeping for further information.
